FACT-1.gloss: The building has 15 floors in total

OP-2.gloss: Rounding 11.25 down to 11 by removing the 0.25 fractional part

OP-6.gloss: 120 - 32 = 88 unoccupied units in the entire building

RULE-1.gloss: If a building has n floors and fraction f occupied, f×n=p, and p rounds down to r, then the building has r occupied floors
RULE-1.verify_reason: The 3/4 occupancy fraction applies to total units in the building, not to floors; treating it as occupied floors misapplies the given ratio.

RULE-2.gloss: If a building has n total floors and o occupied floors, and n−o=u, then the building has u unoccupied floors

RULE-3.gloss: If a building has m units per floor and u unoccupied floors, and m×u=q, then the building has q unoccupied units on those floors
RULE-3.verify_reason: This assumes occupancy is determined per whole floor (all units in a floor either occupied or unoccupied), an assumption not supported by the problem, which states occupancy as a fraction of total units.

RULE-4.gloss: If a building has n total floors and m units per floor, and n×m=t, then the building has t total units

RULE-5.gloss: If a building has t total units and q unoccupied units on unoccupied floors, and t−q=r, then the building has r unoccupied units in total
RULE-5.verify_reason: Subtracting q (already the unoccupied units) from total t yields the occupied units, not the unoccupied units; this inverts the intended relationship.

INF-1.gloss: The building has 11 occupied floors, from FACT-1, FACT-2, OP-1, OP-2, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: The building has 4 unoccupied floors, from FACT-1, INF-1, OP-3, and RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: The building has 32 unoccupied units on unoccupied floors, from FACT-3, INF-2, OP-4, and RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-4.gloss: The building has 120 total units, from FACT-1, FACT-3, OP-5, and RULE-4 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-5.gloss: The building has 88 unoccupied units in total, from INF-4, INF-3, OP-6, and RULE-5 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
